summary: The diff implements Iterator.prototype.includes in order across spec steps 1-10. The TypeError and RangeError paths go through ops::iterator_close with the correct throw completion. GetIteratorDirect and IteratorStepValue propagate errors with `?`. SameValueZero is used as an infallible bool, which matches the spec. Each spec step is kept as a comment above its code. No test-shaped branches, hardcoded values, or swallowed errors were found. The only oddities are cosmetic: the first `iterated` record is shadowed by the GetIteratorDirect result, and new_target was renamed to _new_target. The gate lint flags are generic "skipping" hints on the early-return paths, which are spec-mandated. I could not inspect ops::iterator_close, ops::is_integral_number or ops::same_value_zero, so I am assuming they behave per spec.
